title: Charging power enhancement at the phase transition of a non-integrable quantum battery
summary: Exploiting many-body interaction and critical phenomena to improve the performance of quantum batteries is an emerging and promising line of research. A central question in this direction is whether quantum phase transitions can enhance the charging energy or the power. While preliminary works have addressed this problem in fine-tuned integrable models, its characterization in non-integrable systems remains limited due to the demanding numerical requirements.
